purpose.zh: 练大腿和臀部，提升单腿力量
purpose.en: Build your thighs and glutes for single-leg strength.

text.zh: 双脚前后站定不动，身体直直往下沉
text.en: Stay in your split stance and lower straight down

text.zh: 前脚整只踩地，前膝对着脚尖。
text.en: Keep your whole front foot down and your front knee over your toes.

text.zh: 用前脚推地站起，上身挺直。
text.en: Push through your front foot to rise, keeping your chest tall.

commonErrors.en: Letting the front knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不舒服时蹲浅一点，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your knees feel uncomfortable, go less deep, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 文案与动画一致，改口语；结束口令按 0.8 s 缩为「站起」
节奏核对：动画顶点真正静止约 0.37 秒（<0.8），rep_hold 改为 rep_updown
